items.html: And it is found that necessarily Rachel must now descend and spread into the world of Beria. And necessarily it is the tenth, lower point that spreads in Beria, and it is the Malchut of Rachel — and remember this. However, know that it is written in my notebooks the opposite of this, which I heard from my master of blessed memory once: that the nine points that come to Rachel by way of additions — these joined and united with Leah and became one Partzuf, and remained above in Atzilut; but the root point of Rachel, which was in her at the time of the Atzilut, does not join with Leah, and it is what descends below to Beria at Chatzot.
